status: Implemented and CPU-tested; queued behind completion and improvement of the current Leduc reproduction; no Astra SFT has run
scope: Proposed Astra extension to LeAct, with standalone deployment as the primary goal
relationship_to_v1: v1 supplied the teacher explanation only to backward generation. v2 adds an assisted forward training task while retaining the forward task without teacher information.

variables.pi_A: Frozen Astra action policy, identical in both forward tasks
variables.h_A: Qualitative description of pi_A, used only by the backward proposal
variables.r: Frozen public decision explanation generated by Astra after committing pi_A
variables.c: r when the explanation is supplied; empty when it is omitted
variables.theta_old: Student parameters frozen during candidate generation and selection

factorization: p_theta(z,y | x,c) = p_theta(z | x,c) p_theta(y | x,z,c)

per_trace_losses.assisted_forward: ell_r = -log p_theta(z | x,r) - sum_y pi_A(y|x) log p_theta(y | x,z,r)
per_trace_losses.standalone_forward: ell_0 = -log p_theta(z | x) - sum_y pi_A(y|x) log p_theta(y | x,z)

objective: L = E_selected[lambda_b ell_b + lambda_r ell_r + lambda_0 ell_0]

weight_proposal.interpretation: Preserve the total forward-versus-backward loss weight. These are proposed hyperparameters, not an existing paper prescription.
weight_proposal.compute_control: Use a 50/50 supplied-versus-omitted r mixture on forward examples, or explicitly weighted duplicate examples under a matched optimizer-update budget. Record actual supervised tokens; longer inputs still add computation.

scoring.kl_identity: Delta_c = KL(pi_A || b_c) - KL(pi_A || p_theta_old(.|x,z,c)), for distributions where the log ratios are defined
scoring.primary_admission: Keep up to K candidates with positive Delta_empty, ranked by Delta_empty
scoring.assisted_diagnostic: Also measure Delta_r using baselines that receive the same r
scoring.decomposition: E_y~pi_A[log p_theta_old(y|x,z,r) - log b_empty(y|x)] = Delta_empty(z) + Gamma(z)
scoring.implementation: Use parsed action-policy distributions and explicitly retain the existing capped-KL scoring convention in the implementation. Clipping is a proxy; do not claim the uncapped algebra remains exact after clipping.

deployment.primary: Generate fresh z ~ p_theta(z|x), then predict y ~ p_theta(y|x,z). Neither step receives r or the expert action hint.
deployment.diagnostic: Generate fresh z ~ p_theta(z|x,r), then predict y ~ p_theta(y|x,z,r). Label this as teacher-assisted evaluation.
deployment.caveat: Giving the decoder a trace generated with r is a trace-utility check, not standalone end-to-end evaluation. The trace can still contain information derived from r.
deployment.evaluation_authority: CFR remains the independent evaluator; Astra supplies the training targets.

mathematical_scope.objective_type: A weighted multitask/distillation objective, not a product of three conditional probabilities
mathematical_scope.proposal_bound: For either c, log p_theta(y|x,c) >= E_q[log p_theta(z|x,c) + log p_theta(y|x,z,c) - log q(z|x,y,r)], assuming proposal support. Thus q may use privileged r even for c=empty.
mathematical_scope.approximation: Positive-delta top-K selection and shared selected traces across the two forward tasks are a practical surrogate. No exact-EM or monotonic-improvement guarantee is claimed for this extension.
mathematical_scope.text_training: The action-space expressions are the formal objective. Existing Leduc code trains serialized policy text with token cross-entropy; this is a surrogate, not a direct gradient through the parsed policy probabilities.

implementation.selection: standalone positive delta; assisted delta diagnostic only
implementation.sft_mixture: one backward plus one forward example per retained trace; balanced 50/50 explanation supplied versus omitted for the v2 forward task; all three views retained
implementation.compute_matching: same retained trace count, examples, batch size and three epochs across arms per round; pre-subsampling admission counts retained
implementation.tests: 57 passed, 2 LLaMA-Factory integration tests skipped locally; full test suite required again on the allocated H100 node
